name: meeting-room-system
description: 獨立企業會議室預約管理系統 - 免滾輪雙欄排版、即時排程軸、月曆預約色塊、同仁名單勾選、預約郵件通知、行前五分鐘通知

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"

author: TsuMing
